name: Resolution Shines As Pearls of Sweat

description.value:
Once per turn, a hit forces a Constitution save. Failure applies Ensnared: AC −1 until the end of its next turn. Refreshes, does not stack.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching nihility Path required.
